source_caption:
Still one of my favourite Spider-Man movies 

​Over two decades later, no modern blockbuster, regardless of its endless CGI budget has managed to top the sheer emotional weight of Spider-Man 2. What makes Sam Raimi’s trilogy truly timeless isn't just the practical stunt craft or Tobey Maguire’s raw physical exertion; it’s how fiercely grounded Peter Parker remains. He’s a working-class kid drowning in unpaid rent, failing classes, and losing his personal life, yet he repeatedly breaks his own back for a city that has no idea what it’s taking from him.
